title: Intent-shaped lessons directive in manas-instructions.md
description:
Depends on sutra/276 landing first — this is the FALLBACK for the write-boundary hook, not the primary mechanism.

Rationale for sequencing: orient already surfaces lessons today and agents don't call it. A directive telling them to call it harder treats a structural problem as a compliance problem. Once the guard covers the write path without needing compliance, a directive is worth adding for plan-time lookup.

Frame it as intent-shaped, not orient-shaped: "before writing a new module, sutra_lessons(query=<what you're building>)". Requires sutra/279 (categories as positive retrieval tier) to actually work well.

File: /home/josh/soft/manas/manas-cli/src/adapter/manas-instructions.md, <sutra_mcp> block, lessons section (lines 17-22).
